annotations.title: Inspect and price a task or tool

description: Read one task or provider tool from Ahel's catalog by its id: its exact inputs (Ahel's own contract, or the published reference input when Ahel has none), its status and exact reason, Ahel's price per provider (Unknown when Ahel has no rate), for a temporarily unavailable item the market prices seen elsewhere, for comparison, and the exact run_capability call when it can run. With arguments it also prices that exact run before anything runs: Ahel's quote, the most it may cost, the amount a run would reserve and whether the balance covers it; nothing is reserved, charged or started. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: finding ids, which is capability_search, or running it, which is run_capability.

arguments.description: Optional: the run's inputs, by name, to price that exact run (a quote only; nothing runs).

endpoint_ids.description: With arguments: price the run on these providers only (endpoint ids from this answer).

exclude_endpoint_ids.description: With arguments: price the run without these providers.

id.description: A task id or tool id from capability_search.

max_items.description: With arguments: most rows to price for, 1-100. Default 10.

timeout_seconds.description: With arguments: longest the run may take, 1-180 seconds. Default: the provider's own (60, more for slow sources).

name: capability_inspect
title: Inspect and price a task or tool
